snippet.title: Mega Alien Destroyer (Trailer) (PC shoot 'em up)
snippet.description:
Mega Alien Destroyer is a challenging shoot 'em up for PC, packed with action, varied levels, and bizarre alien and machine bosses. Inspired in the classic shooters of the 80's and 90's like R-Type, the Contra series, Alien Soldier, Eliminate Down, Gynoug, and others.

Download at
http://julianmartinezgames.itch.io

Programming, design, art, soundtrack, everything by Julián Martínez.
